IncidentDef.label: a familiar face at the gate

titles.li: A familiar face at the gate

texts.li: [visit2,friend] {X_nameDef}, the {TALE} who came through last season, is at the gate again, and asked after {A_nameDef} before anything else. The road has been long, {X_pronoun} says, and this was the one door {X_pronoun} wanted to knock on.

[visit2] {X_nameDef}, the {TALE} who came through last season, is back at the gate with the same pack and a new story or two. {X_pronoun} remembered the colony, {X_pronoun} says, better than most places.
[visit3plus,friend] {X_nameDef} is back, as regular as the seasons now. {A_nameDef} saw {X_objective} coming from the far field and had the kettle on before {X_pronoun} reached the gate.
[visit3plus] {X_nameDef} the {TALE} is back again. The children know {X_possessive} name; the dogs don't bark.
[tinker,visit2] {X_nameDef} the tinker is back at the gate, pack clanking, and asks after {A_nameDef} before anything else. {X_pronoun} has a trick or two to show for a warm welcome.
[scholar,visit2] {X_nameDef}, the scholar who stayed a night last season, is back with a bag of notes and a question for {A_nameDef} that has been bothering {X_objective} for weeks.
[doctor,visit2] {X_nameDef}, the doctor who came through last season, is at the gate again with a fresh case of remedies, asking how {A_nameDef} and the others have kept.
[healer,visit2] {X_nameDef}, the healer who came through last season, is back, smelling of herbs, and asks after {A_nameDef}'s health before {X_possessive} own.
[teacher,visit2] {X_nameDef}, the teacher who came through last season, is at the gate with a satchel of books and a lesson {X_pronoun} has been saving for {A_nameDef}.
[cook,visit2] {X_nameDef} the cook is back, and the smell of {X_possessive} pack reached the gate before {X_pronoun} did. {X_pronoun} asked where {A_nameDef} was and whether the stove still smoked.
[scribe,visit2] {X_nameDef} the scribe is back with ink on {X_possessive} fingers and news of three towns, and asks after {A_nameDef}.
[teller,visit2] {X_nameDef}, who told tales at the colony's fire last season, is back with new ones and asks whether {A_nameDef} still sits in the same place.
[kindred,visit2] {X_nameDef}, who talked half a night with {A_nameDef} last season about what they both wanted from life, is back at the gate, and asks straight off how far {A_nameDef} has got.
[cool] {X_nameDef} the {TALE} is at the gate again, though {X_pronoun} wasn't made very welcome last time. {X_pronoun} asks after {A_nameDef} anyway.

[turning,friend] {X_nameDef} is back, and this time {X_pronoun} didn't go to the fire first. {X_pronoun} found {A_nameDef} and said, plainly, that the road is getting long and this is the place {X_pronoun} thinks of when it does. {X_pronoun} would stay, if there were a place; or {A_nameDef} might come along and see the road for a season or two.

[turning] {X_nameDef} is back, and asked to speak to the council. The road is getting long, {X_pronoun} said, and this colony is the place {X_pronoun} thinks of when it does. Would there be a place here for a {TALE}? Or would {A_nameDef} come along and see the road?

li.label: Welcome them in
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} is given a seat by the fire and the evening. {A_nameDef} comes away with something learned.

outcomes.li: [kindred] {X_nameDef} and {A_nameDef} talked until the fire was embers, as before.
[tinker] {X_nameDef} spent the evening by the fire with {A_nameDef}, showing a trick of the trade that {A_nameDef} will use for years.
[teller] {X_nameDef} told the new tales at the fire, and the old favourite once more.

li.label: an evening by the fire with {X_nameDef}
Ask them to stay for good
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} said yes before the question was finished. The {TALE} is one of the colony's now.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} go with them
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} packed that evening. In the morning the two of them set off together down the road, and the colony watched from the gate until they were out of sight.

li.label: Not this time
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} nodded, shouldered the pack, and went on down the road.
